question: Who won a gold medal for weightlifting at the '6th Qatar International cup' in Doha?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Saikhom Mirabai Chanu.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Saikhom Mirabai Chanu won the women's 49kg category gold medal to open India's account at the 6th Qatar International Cup in Doha on 20 Dec 2019.**
 
• She bagged** gold with an effort of 194kg in the Olympic qualifying event**.
 
• She lifted **83kg in snatch and 111kg** in clean and jerk to finish on top of the podium.
 
• She was awarded the** Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna award by the Government of India for the year 2018.**
 
• Chanu had won the** silver medal in the women's 48 kg weight class at the 2014 Commonwealth Games, Glasgow**.
 
• Saikhom Mirabai Chanu is from **Manipur**.
 
• India finished at** 9th position **along with 4 other nations in **World Weightlifting Championship, Anaheim.**
 
• Anaheim is a city outside Los Angeles, in Southern California.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jeremy Lalrinnunga:**

 
 
• Weightlifter Jeremy Lalrinnunga won** India's maiden gold in the men's 62 kg category at the Youth Olympic Games held in Buenos Aries, Argentina in 2018.**
 
• This 15-year-old won the gold medal after lifting a total of **274 kg.**
 
• He belongs to the** state of Mizoram** and he also won a silver and bronze in the 2018 Asian Weightlifting Championships.
 
• India won a total of **13 medals in the 2018 Youth Olympic Games with 3 being Gold, 9 Silver, and 1 Bronze.**
